/quality/deviations/5.deviationDescription: Customer asks to ship the lot with chatter marks outside the functional area.

/quality/deviations/4.deviationDescription: Waive the second coating pass on the inner bore.
/quality/deviations/4.technicalImpact: Does not meet the drawing coating thickness.

approvals.comment: The drawing coating requirement is a safety-relevant corrosion control and cannot be waived.

/quality/deviations/3.deviationDescription: Use alternate steel grade EN19 for the first 300 pieces until the mill delivery arrives.

/quality/deviations/2.deviationDescription: Supplier requests acceptance of gear blanks with 0.1 mm extra stock on the rim.
/quality/deviations/2.qualityImpact: None; stock is removed in machining.
/quality/deviations/2.technicalImpact: Slightly longer cycle time at the customer.

/quality/deviations/1.deviationDescription: Accept forgings with parting-line flash up to 0.6 mm for the trial lot.
/quality/deviations/1.technicalImpact: Flash is removed in the next machining step.

approvals.comment: Technically acceptable for the stated quantity.
Customer accepts the deviation for this lot only.
